profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CaptivateIQ
profile.summary:
Hi!

My name is Faith, and I'm a software developer. I've previously worked with Java/Spring, and now I primarily work as a full stack developer in Django and ReactJS. My hobbies include playing and creating video games that has an emotional and positive impact on communities of color, working with Unity and Renpy depending on the genre of game I want to create. I am also passionate about empowering and mentoring young women in technology through my past leadership positions in Smith College's main Computer Science organization, Smithies in Computer Science. I hope to continue connecting with more women in tech and help build a supportive and inclusive tech community.

If you'd like to get to know more about me and my work as a developer, please feel free to ping me here on LinkedIn :)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrate AI coding tools such as Claude into daily development workflows to accelerate prototyping, debugging, and
feature delivery
• Lead end-to-end delivery of product initiatives from technical design and architecture through implementation, rollout, and
customer launch
• Author technical designs and engineering specifications to drive scalable solutions and align cross-functional teams
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and align technical strategy with business goals
• Serve as acting Engineering Manager, leading sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and team coordination
• Create project plans and Gantt chart to manage dependencies and improve execution visibility
• Delegate projects across engineers to support ownership growth and career development
• Drove Agile process improvements to increase team efficiency and execution velocity
• Organized a week-long engineering offsite, managing budgeting, leadership proposals, logistics, workshops, and team
activities
• Manage and optimize team on-call rotations to improve operational efficiency, balance workload distribution, and support
team productivity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop API’s and UI utilizing Django Rest Framework and ReactJS to streamline sales commission calculations for clients
• Implement Datadog alerts to proactively identify and address performance issues within the application
• Utilize Python scripts to analyze and optimize slow endpoints, resolving n+1 queries to enhance performance
• Lead end-to-end project management, including tech design creation, task delegation, and feature rollout strategies, while
addressing technical debts and bugs
• Establish and monitor Metabase dashboards to track customer adoption of new features
• Collaborate with product managers and designers to define product and UI requirements, prioritizing MVP features for
iterative development
• Conduct cultural interviews for software engineering candidates and train team members in interview techniques
• Facilitate onboarding sessions on our tech stack to mentor new team members
• Participate in support rotations, resolving bugs reported by customers and internal users, and implementing UX
improvements
• Introduce a customizable page component in ChakraUI/ReactJS, ensuring consistent page layout across the application
• Coordinate and execute production releases forthe engineering team using Github Pipeline and AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop new algorithms and features to automate settlements of new products
using Java, Spring
• Create unit tests in Groovy and JUnit, feature files for cucumber testing, and
conduct integration testing to verify expected output across different
applications
• Support and maintain applications in production environment; escalate
settlement failures with technical and business teams to ensure no customer
impact
• Optimize query performance in SQL and monitor performance changes using
Splunk reports
• Develop REST APIs and microservices for importing settlement prices from
third party vendors
• Create builds for monthly releases via Bamboo; support deployments using
XLR and Jenkins Pipeline and verify deployment success using checkout scripts

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: -Hold drop-in hours to accommodate students with questions on programming concepts, assignments, and tools for debugging for courses: Introduction to Python and Data Structures

positions.title: Vice President of Smithies in Computer Science
positions.description:
Host and organize coding workshops, ice cream socials, and hackathons for students interested in Computer Science 

Previous position: Events Chair

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Developed production code for settlement pricing algorithms using Java, SQL, Spring, Maven, Cucumber, Bamboo, Kafka, Groovy
-Participated in daily standups and bi-weekly sprint planning meetings in an agile environment
-Awarded second place for web application "Commodity Analytics Dashboard" for CodeUp, a highly competitive hackathon organized by CME Group; used React, Java, Spring, SQL, Highcharts
-Selected as an apprentice to design and build the intraday pricing engine using micro-service pattern

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
Program: Unity (C#)
-Collaborate with audio engineers to program scripts for audio triggers in game
-Work with lead programmer to debug and polish game mechanics

positions.title: Research Student
positions.description:
Advisor: Nicholas Howe
Research project: Examined the training data of Syriac manuscript to create functions that efficiently translate Syriac words:
-Created two functions in MATLAB: automatically sliced 400+ lines into individual words; manually sliced one line into words for higher accuracy 
-Perused through 200+ words and checked if each word  aligned with the appropriate translation; manually re-sliced each word and created a placeholder function to help align all words to the appropriate translated tag.

positions.title: Event Coordinator of "In the Professional Sphere:  Brianna Wu"
positions.description:
-Invited co-founder of Giant Spacekat Ms. Brianna Wu to Smith College as guest speaker to discuss about working in the game industry as a female programmer
- Organized the budget of the event and fundraised $3700 in two weeks; coordinated event logistics
- Publicized event across campus to maximize awareness; 60 students and faculty members attended

positions.title: Computer Coding Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
-Independently taught 30 seventh and eighth grade students rudimentary coding concepts using platforms Scratch and Code.org. 
-Introduced the syntax and function of tags in HTML and reinforced the practice of organizing HTML codes using CSS; guided each student to fully program and develop their own website. 
-Dedicated 60 hours per week to creating lesson plans, teaching, and attending faculty meetings 
-Received daily feedback from the coding department to perform mock teaching trials and implement lessons centered on hands-on activities for the students' learning experience 
-Part of the Field Trip Committee of six teaching fellows; reserved 350 T Tickets to the State House for seventh and eighth grade students; communicated with students' parents the logistics of transportation and field trip schedule; supervised students to ensure safety throughout the entire trip

projects.title: Commodity Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Used: Java, Spring, SQL, React, Highcharts
Developed a web application that visualizes bid-ask spread data for a given instrument in the form of two separate line charts
Implemented a Twitter feed that illustrates the potential effects of current events on the market for a given instrument
Built a tree map that shows a graphical representation of contract volume per commodity organized by each exchanges (CME, NYMEX, CBOT)

projects.title: CSC 400: The Gaming Lab Search Engine
projects.description:
Blog post: https://medium.com/@faithkim_41270/csc-400-creating-the-gaming-lab-search-engine-spring-2019-e5041140a5e0 

Creating a game inventory search engine for The Gaming Lab at Smith College

Technology: SpringBoot, React, H2DB, Heroku, PostgreSQL, Mockito
